correctness.rationale: Every graph edge of K3^□d lies in exactly one coordinate triangle and every vertex lies in d, hence Hamiltonian is J times sum of ten possible local triple energies F. For any minimizing triple, an affine map of F3^d with nonzero coordinate slopes realizes that triple on every coordinate line; this proves global lower bound is exact including coexistence. For y>0, spin inversion removes four negative-magnetization triple types, leaving six affine branches, with explicit strict-region witness parameters. Order-3 Latin hypercubes are affine (also McKay–Wanless §4); singletons of each coordinate line are parallel affine hyperplane zero sets. Their counts are 3·2^d for all-distinct, 3·2^(d−1) for doubletons, 1 for constant. Uniform random slopes yield P(equal residues)=[1+2(-1/2)^r]/3, covariance v(-1/2)^r, whose factorized Fourier transform vanishes if any frequency coordinate is zero and equals v(3/2)^d otherwise. Independently enumerated all 3^9 configurations for d=2 at six rational witness points and recovered degeneracies 1,6,12,6,6,1; arbitrary-d proof is combinatorial, not this enumeration. Inspected RESULT.md and verification.py blobs.
